beats.text: In Niger, 46.2% of females are children. In Japan, it is 10.7%.
Central African Republic is the world's highest, where 46.5% of females are children.
It counts girls aged 0 to 14 as a percentage of the total female population.
South Korea is the opposite, at 9.9%. A nation with very few children.
Somalia, Mali and Chad are also high, all at 45.5% or more.
Nigeria has 40.4%. That is 3.8 times the 10.7% found in Japan.
The USA has 16.7%, while China is 14.7%.
Does your country have a high share of young females?
